title: Call ego what it is: illness
summary: The point is not self-hatred. The point is honest diagnosis.
takeaway: What is named clearly can stop ruling secretly.
lifeApplication: When you feel offended, ask what wound to the ego you are defending.

source.shortMeaning: Ego is a chronic disease, and Guru's Shabad becomes the cure through grace.

evidence.coreClaim: Ego is a chronic disease, and Guru's Shabad becomes the cure through grace.
evidence.turn: The cure begins when ego is seen as illness rather than identity.
evidence.practicalImplication: When you feel offended, ask what wound to the ego you are defending.
